notes: VS-3 (Phase 1): free, ad-supported - the intermission check rides on this service. Section 26: the script is observe-only (frame.adBreak); presentation actions are invocable only through core's presentation keeper. Nothing else yet by design. Read live 2026-09-19: ?start=true on a title's address autoplays it; the player draws no controls into the DOM while its chrome hides; the feature streams as a single MSE element (blob src). 2026-09-25: videoArtPortrait continue + list - Tubi's cards are tall 2:3 posters (canvas-lb poster art), so the Watch cards take TMDB's landscape backdrop for them ("Tubi is using the vertical orientation for movie posters but we want to try to have the full horizontal card filled"). 2026-09-25: the arrival check (press Play S01:E01 on a show page the play was sent to) runs at every injection, not only the first - Tubi moves within its own app, the script is sent again already installed, and the old guard returned before the check (American Gods sat on its show page with the note still stored). 2026-09-25: the player's full-screen button is now labelled 'Full screen keyboard shortcut f' - enterFullscreen matched the exact label only, so the stage was never entered and Tubi's page showed around the video ('Tubi's chrome is not hidden well. I paused the video and now it's showing me all of tubi's interface around the video'); the labels are matched by their start now. 2026-09-25: the fallback episode link was looked up with a[href^=/tv-shows/] - unquoted, an invalid selector that throws, killing the press loop whenever Play S01:E01 was not drawn yet at the first look (American Gods sat on its show page again, the note still stored); the value is quoted now. 2026-09-25: Continue Watching's cards link to the episode itself (/tv-shows/<id>, The Twilight Zone) - the library read only /movies/ and /series/ links, so the row came back empty ('There is one item in my Tubi continue watching but it doesn't show in Prism'); /tv-shows/ links are read as episodes, and the remove script finds their tiles too ('make sure Remove from continue watching gets hooked up').
